Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestUtcInstant_test_toString.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/threeten-extra/manual/testcases/TestUtcInstant/TestUtcInstant_test_toString.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

Compiles successfully. I refactored `TestUtcInstant_test_toString.java` to focus solely on the `toString()` behaviour: removed the large blocks of dead code (unused data providers `data_badParse`, `data_withModifiedJulianDay`, `data_withNanoOfDay`, `data_plus`, `data_minus`, the `doTest_comparisons_UtcInstant` helper, and their unused imports/constants), grouped the cases with explanatory comments (epoch/fractional precision, time-unit carries, leap second), expressed the magic numbers via the `NANOS_PER_SEC`/`NANOS_PER_DAY` constants, and gave the parameters clear names — all while calling `UtcInstant.ofModifiedJulianDay(...).toString()` with the identical inputs and expected outputs.
